card.name: Linking words before macrolide antibiotic names
card.fires_on: Small linking words or commas right before an expected macrolide or antibiotic name, such as erythromycin or clarithromycin, in drug interaction and contraindication text.

modes.label: Linking word before macrolides
modes.description: A word like other, of, to or similar to comes just before macrolide or erythromycin is expected.
modes.example: CONTRAINDICATIONS Erythromycin is contraindicated in patients with known hypersensitivity<< to>> this antibiotic.

modes.label: Comma in antibiotic lists
modes.description: A comma inside a list of antibiotics, just before the next antibiotic name.
